search_window.basis: bounded hourly lookback from preceding scheduled Food Line Source Watch check; production collector is authoritative

coverage_notes: Supplementary recall watch only; production nationwide collection remains authoritative.

12 targeted web searches completed for (1) sole/last/full-service grocery loss; (2) disaster-related distribution cancellation; (3) abrupt pantry or food-bank service reduction; and (4) official SNAP/WIC immediate interruption.
Search results were predominantly older than the hourly window, general/programmatic, or otherwise excluded; no independently corroborated new qualifying U.S. disruption found.
Coverage is bounded to indexed targeted queries and is not a claim of exhaustive nationwide surveillance.
No editorial approval, publication, schedule change, or automation disabling performed.
